finalText:
All objectives completed and verified.

## Final Report

**1. DONE** — Ticket created: `RD-1015`, title "dab1 RD Bench Ticket", customer "Bench Customer", status Draft. Verified present in the ticket list.

**2. DONE** — Part "dab1 RD Part A" (cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1) added. **Computed price: $125.00** (row read: `dab1 RD Part A | $100.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $125.00`).

**3. DONE** — Part "dab1 RD Part B" (cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1) added. **Computed price: $250.00** (row read: `dab1 RD Part B | $200.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $250.00`). Ticket total at that point: $375.00.

**4. DONE** — Part A's cost edited from 100 → 150. **Computed price afterwards: $187.50** (row read: `dab1 RD Part A | $150.00 | 25% | 1 | No supplier | $187.50`; ticket total $437.50).

**5. DONE** — Status set to **Ready**. The precondition I had to discover and satisfy: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier**. The first "Mark Ready" attempt was rejected with HTTP 409, rendered in the shared error region as:
- Title: `Ticket is not ready`
- Unmet list: `Part "dab1 RD Part A" has no supplier` and `Part "dab1 RD Part B" has no supplier`

I satisfied it by editing each part and setting Supplier = "Northgate Parts" on both. The second "Mark Ready" attempt succeeded with no error, and the status badge read `Ready` (with "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed" buttons appearing, confirming the transition).

**6. DONE** — Both parts removed and the ticket archived. Each delete required a confirm dialog ("Delete the part \"dab1 RD Part A\" from this ticket? This cannot be undone." / same for Part B), which I accepted. After the delayed refresh the parts table showed "No parts on this ticket yet." with 0 part rows. Clicking "Archive ticket" flipped the button label to "Unarchive ticket" and added an "Archived" badge. Final verification on the detail page: `{"title":"dab1 RD Bench Ticket","status":"Ready","archived":true,"partRows":0,"noParts":true}`. The default ticket list (13 items) no longer contains RD-1015; it appears only under "Show archived" (15 items) as `RD-1015 | dab1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer | Ready | 0 | 2026-08-24`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
